scenarios.title: A｜接受道歉
scenarios.setting: 玩家已经到了约好的餐厅，朋友却在最后一刻发消息说来不了了。

turns.text: I’m so sorry. Something came up and I can’t make it tonight. I know this is super last minute.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: It’s okay. Don’t worry about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s okay. Don’t worry about it.
feedback.explanation: 明确说出担心之处，方便对方针对顾虑解释；没有把担心直接说成已发生的事实。

choices.text: No worries. I hope everything’s okay.

feedback.naturalExpression: No worries. I hope everything’s okay.
feedback.explanation: “I hope”表达希望而非保证，适合祝愿或说明对后续的期待。

choices.text: It’s fine. Thanks for letting me know.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s fine. Thanks for letting me know.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Don’t worry about it. We can do it another time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Don’t worry about it. We can do it another time.
feedback.explanation: 明确说出担心之处，方便对方针对顾虑解释；没有把担心直接说成已发生的事实。

choices.text: It doesn’t matter.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: It’s okay. Don’t worry about it.
feedback.explanation: “It doesn’t matter”有时像在说这件事不重要；回应朋友道歉，“No worries”更直接表达不介意。

turns.text: I feel terrible. You’re already there, aren’t you?

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, but it’s really okay. These things happen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, but it’s really okay. These things happen.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

choices.text: I am, but don’t stress about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I am, but don’t stress about it.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: Yeah 😂 I guess I’m having dinner by myself tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah 😂 I guess I’m having dinner by myself tonight.
feedback.explanation: 用独自吃晚饭的玩笑表达等人，适合关系熟悉且彼此接受调侃的场合。

choices.text: Don’t worry. Just make it up to me next time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Don’t worry. Just make it up to me next time.
feedback.explanation: “up to”谈限额时表示最多达到某个数量，适合确认包含的额度。

turns.text: I definitely will. Dinner’s on me next time.

turns.prompt: 你想轻松接受对方的补偿提议，会怎么说？

choices.text: Deal 😂

feedback.naturalExpression: Deal 😂
feedback.explanation: “Deal”表示就这么定了；配合轻松表情，适合朋友之间确认约定。

choices.text: I’m holding you to that.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m holding you to that.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: Haha, okay. We’ll call it even then.

feedback.naturalExpression: Haha, okay. We’ll call it even then.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: B｜表达不满
scenarios.setting: 这已经不是朋友第一次临时取消计划。

turns.text: I’m really sorry, but I don’t think I can come tonight.

turns.prompt: 你想表达临时取消安排让你失望，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m honestly a little frustrated. I planned my evening around this.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m honestly a little frustrated. I planned my evening around this.
feedback.explanation: “a little”表示少量或轻微程度，适合表达希望只作小幅调整。

choices.text: I understand things come up, but I wish you’d told me earlier.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand things come up, but I wish you’d told me earlier.
feedback.explanation: 先理解临时有事，再用“wish you’d told me earlier”说明希望提前告知，兼顾体谅与需求。

choices.text: I’m not angry that you can’t come. I’m upset that you waited until the last minute to tell me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not angry that you can’t come. I’m upset that you waited until the last minute to tell me.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: This has happened a few times now, and it’s starting to bother me.

feedback.naturalExpression: This has happened a few times now, and it’s starting to bother me.
feedback.explanation: “a few”表示少量，后接可数名词复数；比只说“一些”更偏向数量不多。

choices.text: You always waste my time.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’m honestly a little frustrated. I planned my evening around this.
feedback.explanation: “always waste my time”把一次等待扩大到长期评价；说明这次等了多久及希望如何改约更具体。

turns.text: I know. I’m sorry. I didn’t realize until just now that I couldn’t make it.

turns.prompt: 关于「朋友放鸽子」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I get that, but I need you to give me more notice when you can.

feedback.naturalExpression: I get that, but I need you to give me more notice when you can.
feedback.explanation: 先承认听懂了对方，再提出自己的顾虑；理解对方的理由并不等于完全同意。

choices.text: Okay, but please understand that my time matters too.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, but please understand that my time matters too.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: I’m not trying to make you feel bad. I just don’t want this to keep happening.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not trying to make you feel bad. I just don’t want this to keep happening.
feedback.explanation: “not trying to”澄清自己没有某种意图，能在提出疑问前减少对方的防御感。

choices.text: I understand, but it’s frustrating when I’m already on my way.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand, but it’s frustrating when I’m already on my way.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

turns.text: You’re right. I’ll do better next time.

turns.prompt: 你已经了解所需信息，想表达感谢并结束交流，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. That’s all I’m asking.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. That’s all I’m asking.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: I appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: Okay. Let’s just try to communicate better next time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Let’s just try to communicate better next time.
feedback.explanation: “next time”把可能的参与留到下次，适合婉拒当下的邀请。

scenarios.title: C｜重新约时间
scenarios.setting: 在“朋友放鸽子”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“重新约时间”。

turns.text: Can we reschedule? I really do want to see you.

turns.prompt: 你想和朋友重新商量见面时间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. When are you free next?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. When are you free next?
feedback.explanation: 先确认对方是否方便，再进入正题，适合需要占用对方时间时开场。

choices.text: Yeah. How about sometime this weekend?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. How about sometime this weekend?
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Of course. Want to try again next Tuesday?

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. Want to try again next Tuesday?
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Sure, but let’s pick a day we both know will work.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure, but let’s pick a day we both know will work.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

turns.prompt: 你想表达认同或相似的感受，会怎么说？

choices.text: Saturday works for me too. How about three?

feedback.naturalExpression: Saturday works for me too. How about three?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Great. Let’s do Saturday then.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Let’s do Saturday then.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Okay, I’m free after two. Pick a time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’m free after two. Pick a time.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: Perfect. Saturday at three it is.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Saturday at three it is.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Great. Let’s check in that morning just to make sure.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Let’s check in that morning just to make sure.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: Deal. I’ll see you Saturday.

feedback.naturalExpression: Deal. I’ll see you Saturday.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
